findings.message:
[P2] All-absent wave hits cooldown gate before typed skip

With this predicate an all-absent C wave now reaches `ingestClosedCWave`, but that function checks `githubCooldowns` before `recoverClosedWave` raises `ClosedCWaveUnrecoverableSkipV1`. The call from `runHostedMatrixMaintenance` therefore throws `C recovery cooldown active` whenever a cooldown row is present with a null or future `retryNotBefore`; the pass ends as `deferred_unexpected_error` and the later recovery phases do not run, so the all-absent wave is still dropped without the typed skip in that environment. At base the early guard returned a no-op and later phases ran. Detect the missing charges before the maintenance gates, or bypass those gates when the only needed charges are missing, so the all-absent case always produces the typed skip.

src/host/modern-matrix-recovery.ts:519-524

summary: The change routes all-absent C waves through the typed skip and the new tests cover all-absent, archived-and-absent, and fully archived cases; the maintenance caller also continues after an unchanged skip. One residual edge remains: an active githubCooldowns row preempts the skip inside ingestClosedCWave, so the maintenance pass defers instead of logging the typed skip. Task 289 is fulfilled.

evidence: `src/host/modern-matrix-recovery.ts` lines 517-524 no longer returns early when no cell is live: `!findReservationV1` keeps missing charges needed, while a fully archived wave still returns an empty set.

For an all-absent wave the needed set contains every cell id and `recoverClosedCWave` raises `ClosedCWaveUnrecoverableSkipV1`; `ingestClosedCWave` converts it to a `skipped` result with `reason: missing_reservation` and the missing ids.

`tests/host/modern-matrix-recovery-archive_test.ts` lines 166-197 add all-absent and archived-and-absent cases asserting the typed skip and exact skipped result; the fully archived case remains a no-op.
`ops/hosted-autonomy-maintenance.ts` lines 101-124 continue past an unchanged typed skip, and `src/host/matrix-aggregate.ts` lines 257-262 defer the missing native reader error until after the skip.
